messages:
anya: Quick UX thread  planning to introduce a split-action group for table rows in compact mode (primary + overflow). goal is denser layout but preserve a11y and predictable focus. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/split-actions. Observed issues: focus ring clipped, dropdown chevron misaligned, and modal launched from action traps focus when toast appears. Thoughts?

lee: split-action sounds good. prefer primary action as labeled button and secondary as icon overflow. for compact mode keep visual 28px but hit target 44px via hit-wrapper. avoid forcing height on buttons.

riley: modal + toast focus trap is tricky. currently when modal opens and a success toast triggers, toast steals focus briefly on screen readers. need to ensure toasts are aria-live polite and not focusable. also keep toasts out of the modal DOM subtree so they don't compete.

tom: on chevron alignment, don't use translate hacks. ensure svg viewBox + inline-flex center. set svg height/width explicitly. example: `.split-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px } .split-btn svg { width:12px; height:12px }`

anya: agree about toasts. propose pattern: render toasts in a top-level portal element (outside modal), aria-live=polite, toast elements should not receive focus. also create tokens for toast durations: token.toast.short/medium/long. current suggestion: 1400/2400/3600ms.

design-bot: token update proposal created: spacing.compact=6px, touch.hitPadding=8px, toast.duration.short=1400ms, toast.duration.medium=2400ms, toast.duration.long=3600ms. PR: #601. :robot_face:

lee: accessibility nit: split-button icon-only overflow needs aria-label and visible focus state. also ensure keyboard interaction: primary activates on Enter/Space, overflow toggles menu via ArrowDown when focused and Enter/Space. add unit test for keyboard nav.

riley: add a test scenario: open modal from row action, trigger toast, assert focus remains in modal and toast is announced without stealing focus. I'll draft the a11y test steps.

tom: CSS note: if card has `overflow:hidden` for shadow, wrap actions in an overflow-visible slot or move actions outside card container. outline-offset token helps avoid overflow changes. propose focus.outlineOffset=3px token.

anya: copy suggestions: change overflow menu label from "More" to context-aware "More actions" and primary label keep explicit verbs ("Start run" -> "Start evaluation"). will update i18n keys.

lee: QA: add visual regression snapshots for compact/split/icon-only states and RTL variations. also ensure long translations truncate with ellipsis and maintain icon spacing.

anya: plan: update Figma, implement hit-wrapper, render toasts in portal, add aria-live rules, add focus.outlineOffset token, change copy keys, and open PR with visual diffs + a11y test plan. aiming to ship next week. ping me for review.

riley: will help write the screen reader test steps.

design-bot: PR created with tokens and initial implementation branch: #601. CI visual snapshots queued. :robot_face:
